correctness.rationale: Exact moment recursion v[n+1]=(1+2δ(-1)^n/n)v[n]+1 follows from conditioning on the complete past and E[S_n]=0. Pairing n=2m,2m+1 gives z[m+1]=(1+δ(1−2δ)/(m(2m+1)))z[m]−4δ²/(2m+1); summable perturbation to z[m]+2δ² log m proves finite constant and O(log m/m) tail. Multiplicative martingale normalization g[n] has positive finite limit even at δ=±1 when started at n=2; predictable quadratic variation tends to Brownian clock and bounded increments give Lindeberg; initial short-time tightness closes t=0. Independently propagated all exact finite S_n distributions for seven δ through n=26, 252 checks. Does not claim uniformity in δ or quantification of Brownian convergence rate.
